held_out_primary_Denzler2016.mechanism: systematic ~2-3x under-prediction: the minimal copy-only model omits endogenous-target buffering, which raises the true derepression threshold above the bare copy number.

rows.measured_note: derepression not observed until >1.3e4 added miR-92 MREs; ~12% of apparent target abundance

held_out_primary_Denzler2016.source: Denzler et al. 2016 Mol Cell 64:565, DOI 10.1016/j.molcel.2016.09.027

held_out_secondary_Mukherji2011.absolute_location_note: absolute location off by ~10x (predicted ~4.4e+03 vs observed ~420); stated plainly, this is NOT a quantitative pass
held_out_secondary_Mukherji2011.measured_note: switch-like (threshold-linear) transition; onset ~60 mRNAs x 7 sites = 420
held_out_secondary_Mukherji2011.qualitative_prediction: conservation law predicts a SHARP threshold: target repressed until target sites approach the miRNA copy number (~2e3), then a switch-like transition to expression
held_out_secondary_Mukherji2011.system: Mukherji et al. 2011 Nat Genet 43:854, DOI 10.1038/ng.905 (miR-20, HeLa)
held_out_secondary_Mukherji2011.validation_kind: SECONDARY qualitative cross-check (directional/structural, NOT a magnitude validation); independent system, DIFFERENT axis = target-mRNA production, not added competitors
